prompt: 为一个从未听说过中文网络梗的文生图模型，写一条独立完整的提示词，让它画出长颈鹿版的「大笑奶龙」（Laughing Nailong / 奶蛙）表情包。只输出提示词。
answer:
A single cute cartoon character in a Chinese internet meme sticker style, flat 2D digital drawing, thick clean black outlines, flat solid colors, minimal shading, plain white background, square sticker composition, no text.

The character is a giraffe-ified version of a chubby yellow blob mascot: a short, round, pudgy body shaped like a soft dumpling or a fat gummy drop, very smooth and rounded with no visible limbs except two tiny stubby arms and two tiny stubby feet. The whole body is bright buttery yellow. It has a comically long, thick, tube-like neck rising from the blob body, covered in large rounded chocolate-brown patches like a giraffe's coat, ending in a small round head. On top of the head are two short rounded ossicones (little knob-tipped giraffe horns), and two tiny round ears. A short tuft of a brown mane runs down the back of the neck, plus a tiny tail with a brown tuft.

The expression is the key: an exaggerated, uncontrollable belly laugh. Eyes are squeezed completely shut into two upward-curving arcs (like "^ ^"), with little laugh-wrinkle lines beside them. The mouth is enormous, wide open and stretched into a huge "D"-shaped laughing grin that takes up most of the face, showing a dark red mouth interior, a single row of flat white cartoon teeth along the top, and a pink tongue. Two round pink blush circles on the cheeks. A few small teardrops fly out from the corners of the eyes from laughing too hard. The long neck is bent slightly backward as if the head is thrown back mid-laugh, and small motion lines around the body suggest it is shaking with laughter. One stubby arm is raised near the belly as if clutching it.

Overall mood: goofy, smug, mocking laughter, extremely simple and childlike, kawaii, meme sticker aesthetic, high contrast, centered, bold and readable at small size.
